response.sql: WITH actor_film_counts AS (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) as num_films FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id) SELECT actor_id, num_films, num_films / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_actor) as proportion, num_films / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_actor) - (SELECT AVG(num_films) FROM actor_film_counts) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_actor) as difference FROM actor_film_counts ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
